name: cursor-sound-toggle
description: Status bar toggle, sound picker with live preview, and a command to play a sound when a task is done.

cursorSoundToggle.volume.description: Playback volume (0-100). Not applied on Windows.

cursorSoundToggle.soundFile.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the sound to play. Leave empty for the platform default. Easiest to set with **Cursor Sound: Choose Done Sound…**.

cursorSoundToggle.replaceNativeChime.markdownDescription: **Which player makes the agent-done sound?** Off (default): Cursor's built-in chime plays (its sound is `cursor.composer.customChimeSoundPath`) and this extension stays silent for agent-done, so you only ever hear one sound. On: Cursor's chime is kept off and this extension plays **Sound File** instead (needs the Cursor `stop` hook, see README). Also required for per-event sounds and the duration/focus filters on agent-done. The ON/OFF toggle, snooze and quiet hours control whichever player is active.

cursorSoundToggle.announceMode.markdownDescription: What to play on completion. `speech` and `both` use **Announce Text** and fall back to the sound if it is empty.

cursorSoundToggle.announceText.markdownDescription: Text spoken on completion, e.g. `{workspace} on {branch} is {status} {duration}`. Variables: `{workspace}`, `{branch}`, `{duration}` (empty if unknown), `{event}` (agent, command, task), `{status}` (finished, succeeded, failed). Can be set per workspace.

cursorSoundToggle.minDurationSeconds.markdownDescription: Stay silent for tasks shorter than this many seconds. Only applies when the duration is known (terminal commands, tasks, or a `duration` passed to the URI trigger).

cursorSoundToggle.onlyWhenUnfocused.markdownDescription: Only announce when the Cursor window is not focused.

cursorSoundToggle.triggers.terminalComma.markdownDescription: Announce when a terminal command finishes (needs shell integration). Combine with **Min Duration Seconds** to ignore quick commands.

cursorSoundToggle.events.markdownDescription: Per-event overrides, keyed by `event.status` (checked first, e.g. `agent.failed`) or just `event`. Events: `agent` (statuses `succeeded`, `failed`, `aborted`), `subagent` and `tool` (tool call failed; both stay silent until listed here), `command`, `task`, or any `event=` your hook sends. Each value may set `sound` (file path), `text` (spoken template), `mode` (`sound`/`speech`/`both`) or `enabled: false` to silence that event. Preview with **Cursor Sound: Test Event Announcement…**.

cursorSoundToggle.quietHours.start.markdownDescription: Start of quiet hours as `HH:MM` (24h), e.g. `22:00`. Needs **End** too. While active, Cursor's done chime is muted and restored afterwards.

cursorSoundToggle.quietHours.end.markdownDescription: End of quiet hours as `HH:MM` (24h), e.g. `08:00`. Overnight ranges work.

cursorSoundToggle.triggers.tasks.markdownDescription: Announce when a VS Code task finishes.
